selection: minimum mean of three segment RMSEs; exact numeric ties prefer baseline tau=1.5, then smaller tau
vss_rule: upstream t7-changes rule, omit final index, v=337.5/(t8-t7), subject only to frozen boundary QC
measure: instantInductionLoop enter time indexed by simulated vehID equal to source ordinal row; comparison is ordinal-row matching, not verified observed identity
validation_claim: conditional observed-boundary, cross-day tutorial transfer; not calibration of the delivery network
windows_child_containment: CreateProcessW STARTUPINFOEX JOB_LIST: child assigned at creation to noninherited KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE Job Object; normal/exception close plus owned-job terminate/wait on timeout; no process enumeration
observation_matching: same ordinal row across stations; no explicit real vehicle identifier exists
observation_qc: preserve every demand vehicle; for each scored segment exclude only raw end<=start; keep raw row/times and eligibility; identical predetermined rule on both days/all candidates
boundary_qc: omit any nonpositive 7->8 difference from VSS updates, so previous valid speed remains; reject if invalid update precedes first valid speed; preserve all raw input
